## Purpose — why this change exists

gfx90a (CDNA2: MI210/MI250) has **no fp8 datapath** — no native fp8 matmul
instruction — and aiter ships no fp8 GEMM below CDNA3. An fp8-dynamic or
W8A16-fp8 checkpoint on ROCm gfx90a today either crashes in `torch._scaled_mm`
("only supported on ... ROCm MI300+") or falls to dequant-to-bf16 emulation.
This adds `TritonW8A16Fp8LinearKernel`: a fused weight-only fp8 (W8A16) Triton
kernel with per-tensor / per-channel scales that runs on gfx90a, registered
in `_POSSIBLE_WFP8A16_KERNELS[ROCM]` ahead of the previously-empty list
(`is_supported()` rejects every other ROCm target, so gfx942/RDNA are
unaffected in effect).

The decode uses the native `fp8e4nv -> bf16` cast, measured faster than the
fp16 bit-trick alternative at every shape tested (variant table in the
module docstring); the fp16 path stays selectable via `decode="fp16"`.

## Motivation

HiSparse (`--enable-hisparse`) enables high-concurrency long-context decode for sparse attention models by keeping only the indexer KV and a small per-request buffer on GPU. It has two structural drawbacks:
